findings.summary: Prototype motion is only partly implemented: the StageLadder trace/dash animation is absent (no strokeDash* in src/features/result), and the entrance motion is not built. DimensionScores.tsx:61 has a scale reveal with motion-reduce:transition-none and a reduced-motion check at :14, so the reduced-motion path is satisfied. Deferred to integration to accept or schedule the prototype motion.

Command `pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/result.spec.ts` was not run: the spec file does not exist in the tree. It is outside this unit's write paths and belongs to integration. It covers AC-dm-28 e2e, AC-dm-29 rendered-text scan, AC-dm-46 390px/axe, and AC-dm-47 reduced motion.

StageLadder.tsx:90 drops the previous-stage trail when previous equals the current stage, so no dashed previous step is drawn. The caption at ResultPage.tsx:167 still reads 'Antes: estágio N', while AC-dm-28 asks for a dashed previous step.

Two 'Seus números' sections render the same CAC/ratio numbers: NumbersAside (ResultPage.tsx:120) and NumbersSummary. This duplicates a heading and content, which is a maintainability and accessibility issue, not a failure.

messages.text: Run `pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/result.spec.ts` once that spec exists to close AC-dm-28 (e2e), AC-dm-29 (rendered-text scan), AC-dm-46 (390px/axe) and AC-dm-47 (reduced motion). Steps: create the spec, then run the command in the project root and check the exit code.

Decide whether the StageLadder trace animation and the entrance motion are required for AC-dm-47 or may be deferred. If required, they belong to a follow-up frontend unit; global.css is outside this unit.

The implementer reported that the httpClient body-less POST fix (Content-Type application/json and '{}' body) is already in src/api/httpClient.ts. This unit did not verify it because the file is outside its write paths. Confirm with the real createApp that start/complete diagnosis and archive/restore company no longer return 415.

ResultPage.tsx:143 maps previous to diagnosis.previous?.stage. The backend findPrevious (server/services/diagnosisService.ts) returns the older completed diagnosis, excluding self, which matches the expected semantics.
